resource_usage.notes: CPU% is Docker's per-container figure (100% = 1 core; host has 10). Under the closed-loop generator the api container is CPU-bound and effectively saturated (peak ~2.4 cores); these figures reflect the throughput ceiling, not steady per-user cost.
